desc: 黄昏书架边低角度金光，双柄奶瓶八屏弧括留白详情
leaf: 双柄透明瓶身宽口径硅胶奶嘴奶瓶
name: 赭金暮光书架弧括奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用黄昏家中原木搁板与两册无字书把一只合盖的双柄奶瓶立进真实生活场景，靠低角度金光和一道长软影在首屏就拉开同类的棚拍白底差异，换来停留与点击
shots.textZone: 左上方深色架影内一行反白主标与一行小一号副标，其下一枚赭金手绘弧括号包住轻量序号 01，主标下仅一笔弧状赭金短划

shots.intent: 把源图那排写着保温时长专利奶嘴与防呛的圆环图标改成原木搁板上三格完全空白的弧括序号位，只搭出疑问框架，一条功效都不复述
shots.textZone: 上方架影内一行小标题与一行小一号副标，其下一条赭金索引线上三枚弧括号序号，三张留白卡各一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图杜撰的防呛机制三行结论改成同一块搁板上被一根竖向立柱分开的两格，右格立本品左格整块空给卖家自贴，同光同影不偏袒，杜绝虚构对比与数值
shots.textZone: 顶部一行对照小标题压一枚弧括序号，左格一整块 ecru 留白卡，两格各一条空白标签线挂在弧括引线上

shots.intent: 把源图露脸母亲微笑与婴儿正脸含瓶的对喂实拍改写成黄昏书架边一双手的怀抱画面，成人从肩下取景、婴儿只给后脑且全程被托抱，让买家代入又不越界
仰视微距交代透明罩盖、圆顶瓶盖环与坐在瓶口内的宽法兰奶嘴的装配关系，用三枚弧括引线撑起做工信任而不写任何结构与功效
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签线，左右各一枚空白标签线，左下一行深棕结构小标题带弧括序号，条目文字全占位

shots.intent: 正侧面交代双柄外展弧度与瓶身轮廓，把源图各处参数与规格断言全改成一条无字标尺与三枚弧括引线，只留空白标签不写任何数字
shots.textZone: 左侧一条无字尺寸示意轨，右侧三行空白标签线挂在弧括引线上，顶部一行轮廓小标题带一枚弧括序号

shots.intent: 把源图那排打勾的材质耐热消毒与琥珀色断言改成横放在搁板上的一张 ecru 卡里的五行空白档案与一整块留证位，字段名与数值一律留空由卖家自行合贴真实资料
shots.textZone: 卡顶一行小标题与一行小一号副标，其下五行空白档案条目（字段名与数值全空），卡底一整块空白留证位，全部条目文字占位

shots.intent: 以三十度俯角在长软影与架影边收口整套暮色赭金视觉，留出一枚空白行动卡与两枚弧括标签，引导语全交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 上部架影留白带放结束标题、一行小一号副标、一枚空白行动卡与两枚空白弧括标签线，板前一条带序号的索引线

style.backgroundSystem: a real home at dusk, never a studio: one open timber shelf board with a satin hand-planed grain reading approximately #7A4A26, its front edge slightly burnished, set into a recessed shelf bay whose back plane falls into a deep brown shade reading approximately #4A2A16 and whose far end dissolves into unlit warmth; the bay is populated only by two or three upright books with completely unmarked blank spines in ecru #E2D8C3 and deep brown #2A1708, and one small unmarked matte stoneware jar; on flat layout screens the same shelf board carries one laid ecru #E2D8C3 card with softly deckled edges as the writing field, still lit by the same low dusk light so the board grain runs under it; depth comes only from the receding board, the shelf upright and the long real shadow; never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a seamless paper sweep, never bed linen or any woven cloth runner, never a hairline technical grid or measurement lattice, never a stone or micro-cement slab, never a podium disc or stacked pastel blocks, never a tangent sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a milky white studio field and never a dark metallic or navy field
style.direction: warm ochre and deep brown dusk-home maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce on a timber book shelf
style.iconSystem: small hand-drawn-style arc brackets holding one numeral, and nothing else: each marker is a shallow open parenthesis-like curve drawn with one slightly uneven pencil-weight stroke in ochre #C6871E on timber and deep brown #2A1708 on the ecru card, cradling one small light sans ordinal 01 02 03 that sits inside the curve; a callout is one single hairline leader that leaves the referenced part at an easy angle, ends in a small open arc bracket exactly on that part and runs out to a completely empty label line; the index row is one short ochre stroke carrying three evenly spaced arc brackets with their ordinals; markers are kept small, always the same size and one single stroke weight; never a rounded-square squircle chip, never a crosshair plus-mark or hairline grid intersection, never a leaf or sprout glyph, never a copper or metal ring, never an orange notch or corner tick, never a filled circular medallion or knocked-out stamp, never a square check mark, never a dotted circle or dot ring, never a bare oversized serif numeral standing on a rule, never a three-dot pagination marker, never a pennant, medal, rosette, star or shield and no pictogram artwork at all
style.lightingSystem: one low golden dusk key at about 3500K entering from camera left at just above board height, skimming the timber so the grain, the book edges and the deckled card edge all rake; it lays one long soft shadow that runs away to camera right and reads as a real readable shadow shape, never a hard-edged cut shadow; the clear body carries one narrow vertical specular along its camera-left flank plus one soft refractive warm caustic pooled on the board at camera right, the collar ring and handle wings read satin with one small warm highlight each, the cap crest one modest grazing highlight; fill is only warm bounce rising off the board, never a cool card; medium contrast, gentle falloff into the unlit shelf interior, no mirror reflection and no hot streak; strictly the same camera-left low direction in every screen, never a camera-right key, never an overhead source, never a high upper-left softbox, never a front-top wash, never a rim-only backlight and never an even flat high-key field
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm ochre, deep brown and ecru maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system set in a real home at dusk; fixed palette of ecru card #E2D8C3 and timber shelf board #7A4A26 as bases, shelf-interior brown #4A2A16 and deep brown text #2A1708 as the dark structure and exactly one warm ochre accent #C6871E; warm tone at about 3500K throughout; background system limited to one open timber shelf board with a satin hand-planed grain inside a recessed shelf bay whose back plane falls into deep brown shade, populated only by two or three upright books with completely unmarked blank spines and one small unmarked matte stoneware jar, flat layout screens laying one deckled-edge ecru card on the same board, depth coming only from the receding board, the shelf upright and one long real shadow, never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a seamless paper sweep, never bed linen or any woven runner, never a hairline technical grid, never a stone slab, never a podium disc or pastel blocks, never a sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a milky white studio field and never a dark navy or metallic field; one low golden dusk key at about 3500K entering from camera left at just above board height, skimming the grain and laying one long soft shadow running to camera right, the clear body carrying one narrow vertical specular on its camera-left flank and one soft warm refractive caustic pooled on the board at camera right, the collar and handle wings satin with one small warm highlight each, fill only warm bounce off the board, medium contrast, gentle falloff into the unlit shelf interior, no mirror reflection, the same camera-left low direction in every screen, never a camera-right key, never an overhead source, never a high upper-left softbox, never a front-top wash, never a rim-only backlight and never a hard-edged cut shadow; one humanist Chinese sans family with softly rounded terminals set flush left, a single short headline in deep brown #2A1708 on the ecru #E2D8C3 card underlined by one short hand-drawn-style ochre #C6871E stroke, one sub-line a size step smaller, at most one small ochre label, ecru #E2D8C3 reversal over the shelf interior, no Latin overprint, no small-caps kicker, no serif, no handwritten body copy, no highlighter band, no boxed headline frame, no pill label, no second font; icon system of small hand-drawn-style arc brackets only, each a shallow open single-weight pencil curve in ochre #C6871E on timber or deep brown #2A1708 on the card cradling one small light sans ordinal, each callout one hairline leader ending in a small open arc bracket exactly on the part and running to a completely empty label line, the index row one short ochre stroke carrying three arc brackets with their ordinals, never a squircle chip, never a crosshair plus-mark, never a leaf glyph, never a copper or metal ring, never an orange notch or corner tick, never a filled medallion, never a square check mark, never a dotted circle, never a bare oversized serif numeral on a rule, never a three-dot marker, never a pennant, medal, rosette, star or shield and no pictogram artwork at all; the bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the shelf board with its clear cap fitted, its collar ring screwed closed and its nipple fully seated inside, the twin swept-down handle wings, the soft shoulder taper, the rounded base, the fine neck seam under the collar, the domed collar and cap in their exact reference tone with no recolouring, the short broad-flanged nipple shape and the small printed motifs near the lower body never redrawn or relocated, the single reference colourway being the only colourway so no second tone, straw insert, spare nipple or accessory is ever invented, any graduation kept exactly as shot and the printed label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cool cast, no arch, paper sweep, linen, technical grid or stone, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical or functional-benefit wording of any kind: no 「防胀气」 「防呛」 「防呛奶」 「锁流」 「自动调节流量」 「均匀出奶」 「不吸瘪」 「轻松断奶」, no anti-colic, air-release, valve, flow-control or choking-prevention assertion, and no mechanism caption implying a health result
no breastfeeding-equivalence or mother-feeling wording: no 「仿妈妈乳头触感」 「还原妈妈乳腺」 「每一口都像妈妈」 「仿生乳感」 「母乳实感」 「妈妈的感觉」 and no soothing or mother-substitute phrasing
no warmth or retention claim: no 「6小时保温」, no 「爱的温度不流失」, no hour or duration figure and no temperature retention statement

no material or safety-grade claim: no 「PPSU」 「PES」 「PP」 「玻璃」 「中硼硅」 「液态硅胶」 「食品级」, no silicone or plastic grade, no BPA-free or 「不含双酚A」 statement, no 「轻盈耐摔」 「耐高温」 「不变形」 durability assertion and no 「瓶身通透呈琥珀色」 material description
no sterilisation, disinfection or antibacterial standard: no 「蒸煮消毒」 「可消毒」 「杀菌」 「抑菌」, no sterilisation rate, no cycle count, no pathogen name and no temperature or minute figure

no certification, patent or research endorsement: no 「权威认证」 「专利认证」 「专利号」, no patent or registration or filing or execution-standard number, no certificate, award, seal, medal, rosette, star or shield artwork, no inspection report and no doctor, hospital, midwife or laboratory endorsement
no origin or import claim: no 「德国进口」, no country name, no flag or landmark artwork and no factory, supplier or heritage wording
no age or stage indication: no 「新生儿」 「宝宝专用」, no month or year range and no wording about who the product suits

no invented numbers anywhere: no capacity in millilitres, no dimension, no mouth diameter, no net weight, no piece or pack count, no shelf life, no 「三大」 count, no multiple, no percentage, no progress bar, no chart and no comparison meter
no price, discount, coupon, countdown, gift, free-shipping or delivery-time wording, no sales count, rating, review score or award claim, no 「加入会员」 「全店免费」 membership block and no QR code

no brand, store or platform residue: no 「BABY LOVE」 wordmark, no 「NEW concept」 Latin overprint, no 「liquid silicone nipple」 Latin caption, no stock-library watermark, no corner tag and no readable label wording; the printed label area is always one blank legible field

no feeding-infant faces and no bottle at a child mouth: any infant appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, is always held and fully supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulders down with anatomically correct hands, and the bottle is never left unattended, never resting on a child and never at the lips

no loose, unsecured, detached, hanging or exploded nipple, collar ring, neck ring or cap: the nipple stays seated and screwed closed inside the fitted cap in every screen, no open ring, no part suspended in air, no inverted bottle and no hand offering a bare nipple
no microwave, no steam, no vapour on skin, no hot liquid touching skin, no pouring water, no droplet and no splash anywhere in the set

no style drift between screens: no palette change, no mixed fonts, no limewash plaster, no arched niche, no seamless paper sweep, no bed linen or woven runner, no hairline technical grid, no stone or micro-cement slab, no podium disc, no pastel block wall, no sphere cluster, no gradient card, no white studio field, no navy or metallic dark field, no squircle chip, no crosshair plus-mark, no leaf glyph, no copper ring, no orange corner notch, no square tick, no dotted circle, no bare serif numeral, no pennant, no camera-right key, no overhead light, no upper-left softbox, no hard-edged cut shadow and no recoloured product or invented second colourway
style.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the shelf board with its clear cap fitted, its collar ring screwed closed and its nipple fully seated inside, the twin handle wings keeping their original swept-down attachment at the collar and never being bent, removed or duplicated; the clear body silhouette from soft shoulder taper to rounded base, the base radius, the fine neck seam line under the collar, the domed collar ring and cap in their exact reference tone with no recolouring, the short broad-flanged nipple shape and the small printed motifs near the lower body are never redrawn, relocated, resized or restyled; the reference set shows one colourway only, so no second colourway, no straw insert, no spare nipple and no extra accessory is ever invented; any graduation marking stays exactly as shot and is never added, removed or enlarged; the printed label area always reads as one blank legible field carrying no redrawn wording; the product never floats without its contact shadow, is never occluded by books or by the shadow shape, vertical lines and the shelf upright stay strictly vertical, and one real unmarked object anchors scale in every scene screen
style.surfaceSystem: the timber shelf board is the only standing surface: satin open grain with a touch of sheen along the front edge, the bottle settling onto it with true weight, one tight warm contact shadow hugging the base radius and one long soft cast shadow to camera right; the clear bottle body renders as real thick-wall transparent stock with believable refraction, edge darkening and one internal caustic, never as a frosted matte surface and never as a mirror; the collar ring, neck ring and handle wings render as soft satin moulded pieces with a readable step edge, never as hard glossy rubber; the nipple inside the closed cap renders as real soft elastomer with internal shading and a broad flange, never as shiny plastic; the ecru card reads as matte fibrous stock with visible deckle, not as paper-white plastic
style.typography: one humanist Chinese sans family with softly rounded terminals throughout, set flush left on an invisible editorial measure; a single short headline in deep brown #2A1708 sitting on the ecru #E2D8C3 card with one short hand-drawn-style ochre #C6871E stroke underlined beneath it as the only decoration, one sub-line in the same family a size step smaller, at most one small ochre label, and reversal to ecru #E2D8C3 when type crosses the deep brown shelf interior; per-screen copy budget kept to one headline, one sub-line and two or three short labels, no dense body text, no Latin overprint or small-caps kicker strip, no serif or Ming-style lettering, no handwritten body copy, no keyword highlighter band, no boxed headline frame, no pill or capsule label, no stacked ribbon tag and never a second font
